facts.text: Thompson Austin sits above 5th and San Jacinto in downtown Austin, in a 32-story sustainable development.
facts.excerpt: Thompson Austin is a luxurious hotel perched above 5th and San Jacinto in a stylish 32-story sustainable development

facts.text: All accommodations have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views, hardwood floors, leather furnishings, cast concrete and stone mosaics.
facts.excerpt: All accommodations feature floor-to-ceiling windows with dramatic cityscape views of Austin, hardwood floors, leather furnishings, cast concrete and stone mosaics.

facts.text: The Upper Stories suites are on the hotel's topmost floor and are multi-room suites with kitchens.
facts.excerpt: Each unique suite, perched on our topmost floor, is designed with high-end touches curated to indulge your senses and elevate your stay.

facts.text: Upper Stories guests can arrange pre-arrival grocery stocking, in-room massage and wellness treatments through a personal VIP concierge.
facts.excerpt: from pre-arrival grocery stocking for use in the well-equipped kitchens, in-room massage, wellness treatments and more

facts.text: The pool deck is on the 4th floor, with cabanas, daybeds and loungers.
facts.excerpt: our 4th-floor pool deck offers an urban oasis where you can get lost in the moment. Luxe cabanas, daybeds, comfortable loungers, and large sun umbrellas welcome you to laze the day away.

facts.text: Arriba Abajo is a Mexican rooftop restaurant and bar on the 4th floor with downtown Austin views.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in delicious Mexican cuisine and downtown Austin views at our rooftop restaurant and bar, Arriba Abajo.

facts.text: On Thursday nights Arriba Abajo offers an omakase-inspired dinner paired with mezcals and mezcal cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Mezcal, Tambien at Arriba Abajo pairs a six-course, omakase-inspired seasonal menu with mezcals and mezcal cocktails in the intimate Tambien Mezcaleria on Thursday nights.

facts.text: The Royale Room is a seventies-inspired cocktail lounge known for martinis.
facts.excerpt: A seventies inspired cocktail lounge with ice cold martini and contemporary cocktails, reimagined with the Austin spirit.

facts.text: Fifth Street Diner is a classic American-style diner serving all-day staples such as omelets and a smash burger.
facts.excerpt: Fifth Street Diner is a nostalgic nod to the classic American diner, blending retro charm with a contemporary twist.

facts.text: The Coffee Bar serves coffee from Texas Coffee Roasters.
facts.excerpt: Start your day with coffee from Texas Coffee Roasters at The Coffee Bar.

facts.text: The fitness center covers over 6,700 square feet with Peloton bikes, Technogym treadmills and a private studio space.
facts.excerpt: Keep your fitness routine in motion on the road with over 6,700 square feet of space.

facts.text: The hotel has a Full Swing sports simulator.
facts.excerpt: Try our Full Swing sports simulator for endless options and a fun competition.

facts.text: Tommie, a separate boutique hotel, sits within Thompson Austin and shares its amenities.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within Thompson Austin, you’ll find tommie, a boutique hotel with access to all of the Thompson luxury amenities.

facts.text: The five event spaces are named after Texas outlaws: Kelley, Red River, Singer, Newton and Bass.
facts.excerpt: Kelley, Red River, Singer, Newton, and Bass — all were famous outlaws around Texas in the early 1800s until the 1900s.

facts.text: Dogs stay at no additional charge, with a maximum of two pets.
facts.excerpt: Our pet-friendly hotel in the heart of the city welcomes dogs at no additional charge.

facts.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room.
facts.excerpt: A daily destination fee of $35.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

facts.text: The destination fee includes use of hotel cruiser bikes, based on availability.
facts.excerpt: Use of hotel branded cruiser bikes (based on availability)

facts.text: Austin-Bergstrom International Airport is about 9 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
Austin–Bergstrom International Airport (AUS)

9 Miles

facts.text: Rooms have D.S. & Durga bath amenities and rainfall showers.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully appointed with a spa-inspired rainfall shower, D.S. & Durga bath amenities, and signature Thompson robes

facts.text: The lobby has rich leather furnishings, a monolithic fireplace and petrified wood ceilings.
facts.excerpt: an elegant lobby dressed up in rich leather furnishings, a monolithic fireplace, and petrified wood ceilings

facts.text: The hotel has LEED Silver certification and is an Austin Energy Green Building.
facts.excerpt: The Thompson has LEED Silver certification and is an Austin Energy Green Building.

facts.text: A short walk leads to the Lady Bird Lake hike and bike trail and Republic Square.
facts.excerpt:
A short walk gets you to
Lady Bird Lake
hike and bike trail, as well as Republic Square

facts.text: Antone's Nightclub and the Paramount Theater are nearby.
facts.excerpt: 3\. Antone's Nightclub

facts.text: The destination fee includes access to ticketed events at Antone's with a bar tab, based on availability.
facts.excerpt: Access to ticketed events at Antones with up to $100 bar tab (based on availability through Concierge)

facts.text: The hotel can provide roll-away cribs and kid-friendly foods.
facts.excerpt: The hotel can accommodate babies and kids with amenities such as roll-away cribs and kid-friendly foods

facts.text: There is no spa on site.
